name: sprint1_retrieval
description: Sprint 1 retrieval quality dataset. Memories use the /ai/memories/process request shape so they feed the real pipeline unchanged. Queries carry the memory ids a correct system should return; an empty list means the correct answer is no match.

memories.title: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
memories.description: Atlas Vector Search stores embeddings in a vector index and retrieves documents by semantic similarity rather than keyword matching. The index definition needs numDimensions and a similarity metric such as cosine. Filters can be applied before the nearest-neighbour scan.
memories.whySaved: Reference for the memory retrieval layer

memories.title: pgvector extension for Postgres
memories.description: pgvector adds a vector column type to Postgres with ivfflat and hnsw index types. Cosine distance uses the vector_cosine_ops operator class. Good when you already run Postgres and do not want another datastore.
memories.whySaved: Alternative to a dedicated vector database

memories.title: Choosing an embedding model
memories.description: Smaller embedding models are cheaper and faster but lose nuance on long documents. Multilingual models matter when users write in more than one language. Always check the output dimension against what your index expects.
memories.whySaved: Was comparing options for the AI service

memories.title: Chunking strategies for RAG
memories.description: Fixed-size chunks are simple but cut sentences in half. Splitting on headings and paragraphs keeps meaning intact. A small overlap between chunks stops an answer being lost at a boundary.

memories.title: Python asyncio notes
memories.description: Use asyncio.to_thread to move blocking CPU work off the event loop. asyncio.gather runs coroutines concurrently. Never call a synchronous database driver directly inside an async request handler.
memories.whySaved: Keep the API responsive under load

memories.title: Modern Python typing
memories.description: Use the built-in generics like list[str] instead of typing.List. Protocol classes give structural typing without inheritance. Run mypy in strict mode to catch missing annotations early.

memories.title: Docker layer caching
memories.description: Copy the dependency manifest and install packages before copying application source, so a code change does not invalidate the dependency layer. Multi-stage builds keep the runtime image small.
memories.whySaved: CI builds were far too slow

memories.title: When Postgres ignores your index
memories.description: The planner skips an index when it estimates most rows will match anyway. Check with EXPLAIN ANALYZE. Stale statistics after a bulk load are a common cause; run ANALYZE afterwards.

memories.title: Interactive rebase for tidy history
memories.description: Squash fixup commits before opening a pull request so reviewers see one coherent change per commit. Never rebase a branch other people have already pulled.

memories.title: JWT expiry and refresh tokens
memories.description: Keep access tokens short lived and rotate refresh tokens on every use. Store refresh tokens server side so they can be revoked. A long-lived access token cannot be withdrawn once issued.

memories.title: Sourdough starter routine
memories.description: Feed the starter with equal parts flour and water each morning and discard half before feeding. A healthy starter doubles within six hours and smells sweet rather than sharp.

memories.title: Fresh pasta dough ratio
memories.description: One hundred grams of flour per egg. Knead for ten minutes until smooth, then rest the dough wrapped for thirty minutes before rolling so the gluten relaxes.

memories.title: Pour-over coffee ratio
memories.description: Sixty grams of coffee per litre of water. Bloom with twice the coffee weight for thirty seconds, then pour in slow circles. Grind finer if the brew tastes thin and sour.

memories.title: Half marathon training plan
memories.description: Build weekly distance by no more than ten percent. One long slow run at the weekend, one interval session midweek, and at least two rest days. Taper for the final two weeks.

memories.title: Sleep hygiene basics
memories.description: Keep a consistent wake time even at weekends. No caffeine after midday and no bright screens in the last hour. A cool dark room matters more than total hours in bed.

memories.title: Quarterly tax filing deadlines
memories.description: Estimated payments fall due in April, June, September and January. Late payment attracts interest from the original due date, not from when you notice.

memories.title: Why low-cost index funds
memories.description: Fees compound against you exactly as returns compound for you. A broad market tracker with a low expense ratio beats most actively managed funds over twenty years.

memories.title: Lisbon trip notes
memories.description: Stay in Alfama for the old town but expect steep hills. The tram queues are shortest before nine in the morning. Book the Belem pastry shop visit on a weekday.

memories.title: Learning barre chords
memories.description: Press with the bony edge of the index finger rather than the flat pad. Practise the F shape slowly and build strength before increasing tempo. Sore fingers pass after two weeks.

memories.title: Watering houseplants properly
memories.description: Water deeply but less often, and let the top few centimetres dry out first. Yellow drooping leaves usually mean too much water rather than too little.

memories.title: البحث الدلالي بالمتجهات
memories.description: البحث بالمتجهات يخزن التضمينات في فهرس ويقارن التشابه الدلالي بين النصوص بدلا من مطابقة الكلمات المفتاحية. يستخدم مقياس جيب التمام لحساب درجة التشابه بين المتجهات.

memories.title: رحلة إلى اسطنبول
memories.description: أفضل وقت للزيارة هو الربيع قبل موسم الازدحام. احجز الفندق في منطقة السلطان أحمد وتنقل ببطاقة المواصلات فهي أوفر بكثير من سيارات الأجرة.

memories.title: طريقة القهوة العربية
memories.description: تحمص البن تحميصا خفيفا ثم يطحن ناعما مع الهيل. تغلى القهوة على نار هادئة ولا تترك حتى تفور بقوة حتى لا يفقد الطعم نكهته.

memories.title: ميزانية شهرية بسيطة
memories.description: قسم الدخل إلى ثلاثة أقسام: المصاريف الأساسية والادخار والمصاريف الشخصية. راجع المصاريف في نهاية كل شهر وسجل كل مبلغ مهما كان صغيرا.

memories.title: RAG pipeline ملاحظات
memories.description: الـ retrieval augmented generation بيعتمد على chunking للنص ثم embedding لكل chunk وبعدين vector search علشان نجيب الـ context قبل ما نبعته للموديل. الجودة بتعتمد على الـ retrieval مش على الـ prompt.
memories.whySaved: مرجع سريع for the AI service

memories.title: Daily standup بالفريق
memories.description: الـ standup لازم يكون خمستاشر دقيقة بالكتير. كل واحد يقول عمل ايه امبارح وهيعمل ايه النهاردة وفيه ايه blockers. النقاش الطويل يتأجل لـ meeting منفصل.

memories.title: React list keys
memories.description: Give each list item a stable key from your data, never the array index. Using the index makes React reuse the wrong component when the list is reordered or filtered.
memories.whySaved: Bug took an afternoon to find

memories.title: CSS grid versus flexbox
memories.description: Grid lays out two dimensions at once and suits page structure. Flexbox handles one axis and suits toolbars and button rows. Reach for grid when you find yourself nesting flex containers.

memories.title: Rate limiting strategies
memories.description: A token bucket allows short bursts while capping the sustained rate. A fixed window is simpler but lets twice the limit through at a window boundary. Always return how long the client should wait.

memories.title: On-call handover checklist
memories.description: Write down anything still firing, anything silenced and why, and any change shipped in the last day. The next person should not have to reconstruct the week from dashboards.
